1_executive_email.body:
Dear Catheter OEM (Medtronic Technology Scouting / R&D Leadership,

I am writing to present a technology-transfer opportunity that may be of strategic interest to Catheter OEM (Medtronic.

## Technology
P-27 — Shape-Memory Polymer Catheter with Kink-Resistant Geometry

## Why This May Matter to Catheter OEM (Medtronic, Integra, Codman) or shape-memory polymer company
Kinking causes 8% of catheter failures. Helical SMP geometry with active kink recovery is a materials-based solution. Could extend to other catheter applications (vascular, neurovascular).

## Current Evidence
- Technical readiness: T1
- Physical validation: NONE
- Evidence is transparent and auditable — every claim traces to a source artifact

## What Is NOT Proven (Honest Disclosure)
- NO_FAILURES_TESTED_YET — all evidence is MODELLED. SMP fatigue over 5+ year implantation unknown. Helical geometry manufacturing feasibility not yet assessed.

## What We Are Asking
Commission $18K bench test (including accelerated aging) OR request manufacturing feasibility assessment

## Validation Investment
A defined experiment ($$18K (includes accelerated aging), 14 weeks to T2, 12-18 months to T3) can upgrade this from T1 to externally verified status.

## Next Step
If this is of interest, I would welcome a 30-minute call to discuss:
1. Whether this fits your strategic roadmap
2. What evidence you would need to evaluate further
3. Whether a sponsored validation or co-development structure makes sense

I can share the full technical dossier under NDA.

Best regards,
[CEO Name]
CereVascular

2_one_page_opportunity_summary:
# P-27 — Technology Transfer Opportunity

**Technology:** P-27 — Shape-Memory Polymer Catheter with Kink-Resistant Geometry
**Buyer:** Catheter OEM (Medtronic, Integra, Codman) or shape-memory polymer company
**Current Evidence:** T1 | NONE
**Recommended Transaction:** SPONSORED_VALIDATION ($18K bending + aging)
**Validation Cost:** $18K (includes accelerated aging) (14 weeks to T2, 12-18 months to T3)

## Problem
Catheter obstruction causes 30-50% of shunt failures. Mechanical kinking contributes to 8% of failures. Existing catheters are passive tubes with no kink resistance. Need geometric self-supporting cat

## Technology
P-27 — Shape-Memory Polymer Catheter with Kink-Resistant Geometry

## Strategic Value
Materials solution to kink failure — platform for all catheters

## What Is Proven
- Computational model: yes
- External verification: no
- Physical validation: no

## What Is NOT Proven
- NO_FAILURES_TESTED_YET — all evidence is MODELLED. SMP fatigue over 5+ year implantation unknown. Helical geometry manufacturing feasibility not yet assessed.

## Strongest Alternative
Reinforced silicone catheter (existing) — mechanical reinforcement but no active kink recovery

## Decisive Question
Does SMP maintain recovery force after 5+ years at 37°C? Can helical geometry be manufactured at catheter scale (1-2mm ID)?

## What We Are Asking You to Do
Commission $18K bench test (including accelerated aging) OR request manufacturing feasibility assessment

## BUYER_ACTION_ID: BA-P27-001
